revenueModel.text: Capital Markets earns fees from underwriting, advisory services, sales and trading commissions, and interest income from loans and securities lending. Wealth Management earns investment advisory fees based on assets under management.
revenueModel.evidence: Fees earned from corporate finance and investment banking services are derived from debt, equity and convertible securities offerings in which the Company acted as an underwriter or placement agent.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company sold its Appraisal and Valuation Services, Retail, Wholesale & Industrial Solutions and Real Estate businesses through the Great American Group transaction.
changes.evidence: In November 2024, the Company completed a transaction in which (1) it and certain of its subsidiaries contributed all of the interests in the Company's Appraisal and Valuation Services, Retail, Wholesale & Industrial Solutions and Real Estate businesses to Great American Holdings, LLC.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold GlassRatner Advisory & Capital Group, LLC and B. Riley Farber Advisory Inc., which were part of the Capital Markets segment.
changes.evidence: In June 2025, the Company sold all of the membership interests of GlassRatner Advisory & Capital Group, LLC and B. Riley Farber Advisory Inc., for cash consideration of approximately $117.8 million.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold a portion of its Wealth Management business to Stifel Financial Corp.
changes.evidence: In April 2025, the Company sold a portion of the Company's (W-2) Wealth Management business to Stifel Financial Corp. ("Stifel") for net cash consideration of $26.0 million.
